description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across different categories, including Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the categories, listed in the order of Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, while the vertical axis is labeled "Execution Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, marked at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with NatSQL represented by light blue bars and TA-SQL by dark blue bars. For each category, the NatSQL and TA-SQL bars are paired together, with the NatSQL bar positioned first. The execution accuracy values for NatSQL are approximately 60.21, 39.64, 32.32, and 51.35 for Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, respectively, while the corresponding values for TA-SQL are approximately 63.14, 48.60, 36.11, and 56.19. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively compares the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across the different categories.
